# watchpoint_status_page_translation (Resource)

Translations of a status page's own text into one language. Visitors who pick that language see these values in place of the authored text. Only the entries listed here are managed, so translations added in the portal (for example of incident updates) are left alone. Pair it with `enabled_languages` on `watchpoint_status_page`. Requires the `status_page_localization` feature and `status_pages.manage`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_status_page_translation" "fr" {
  status_page_id = watchpoint_status_page.public.id
  language       = "fr"

  entries = [
    { entity_type = "page", entity_id = watchpoint_status_page.public.id, field = "name", value = "Statut Acme" },
    { entity_type = "component", entity_id = watchpoint_status_page_component.api.id, field = "name", value = "API publique" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entries` (Attributes Set) Translated values, one per entity field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `language` (String) Target language: `en`, `de`, `fr`, `es`, `pt-BR`, `ja`, `nl`.
- `status_page_id` (String) The status page.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<status_page_id>/<language>`.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Required:

- `entity_id` (String) ID of the entity; it must belong to this status page.
- `entity_type` (String) `page`, `component`, `group`, `incident`, `incident_update` or `maintenance`.
- `field` (String) `name`, `description`, `footer_text` (page), `title` (incident, maintenance) or `body` (incident_update).
- `value` (String) The translated text.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_status_page_translation.fr <status-page-id>/fr
```
